newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Accumulate Thai Farmers - Seamico.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Accumulate Thai Farmers - Seamico.

text.p: Seamico Securities recommended on Friday that investors accumulate Thai Farmers Bank Plc after it reported profit growth of 2.5 percent for 1996.
"The result was in line with our expectation of 12.087 billion for the year," Seamico said.
Thai Farmers Bank, one of Thailand's top five commercial bank, reported unaudited net profit of 11.862 billion baht for 1996.

Seamico said even though a deterioration of the bank's loan quality was envisaged during the current economic downturn, the bank's non-performing loans at under five percent was still well below the industry average of around six-seven percent.
It estimated that the bank's loan growth would recover to 13 percent this year and 15 percent in 1998.
Non-interest income was estimated to recover in 1997 and record growth of around 12-13 percent while the bank's non-interest expenses would grow by around 11 percent.
"Spreads in 1997 are estimated to be slightly better than in 1996 -- 4.19 percent compared with 4.12 percent respectively," Seamico said in the report.
"However, the spread is estimated to narrow to 4.14 percent in 1998 due to stronger competition in both lending and deposits," it said.
